headline: See every use of a clip as a picture, including the footage you never used.
notes: Three ways to see a clip's uses, like Premiere's own: List, List with thumbnails, and Icon view. Switch with the buttons at the top right
A size slider in the bottom bar makes the thumbnails bigger or smaller, or the text in List view, and it moves smoothly while you drag
Unused footage gets thumbnails too, made automatically in the background and remembered, so a clip only makes them once
When the same shot is used more than once, its uses fold under the first one, marked ×2, ×3. Click to open them, or press Show all takes. You can turn this off in Filters › Group repeated shots
Filters now has Colour labels, to show or hide the coloured bar on each use
The Source Monitor button sits after the REPEAT or OTHER tag in List view, and only shows on the row you point at
The bottom bar stays on one line as you make the plugin narrower: Select all becomes its tick icon, then the slider shortens
With Follow timeline clicks on, a clip you click in the Project panel now stays on screen, rather than switching back to the clip selected on the timeline
The thumbnails for unused footage come from a sequence kept in a bin called Trace previews (Do not delete). Each one adds a "Trace+ previews" step to Edit › Undo the first time a clip makes them
